services.title: Product Demo
services.body: Show the product in real life, with a clear use case and simple reasons people should care.

services.title: Unboxing
services.body: Make first impressions feel genuine while highlighting what matters most about the product.

services.title: Lifestyle Content
services.body: Place your product inside everyday family, food, beauty, or home moments people relate to.

services.title: Voiceover
services.body: Use natural narration to explain benefits, handle objections, and keep the video moving.

services.title: Testimonial
services.body: Create honest, direct-to-camera content that builds trust and gives viewers a reason to act.

process.title: Inquiry
process.body: Send the product, goal, timeline, and deliverables so everything is clear from the start.

process.title: Strategy Call
process.body: Hayley confirms the audience, key message, hook ideas, and what success should look like.

process.title: Create
process.body: She films content that feels native to TikTok while still keeping your brand goal in focus.

process.title: Deliver
process.body: You get clear, ready-to-use assets on schedule, with communication throughout the process.
